steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Absolute: produce more with same resources; Comparative: lower opportunity cost -> specialise -> trade

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Tariff: tax on imports -> domestic P↑, Qd↓, Qs↑, govt revenue, DWL; Quota: quantity limit; Subsidy: domestic producers

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Floating: market; Fixed: central bank intervention; Managed: dirty float; PPP: identical goods same price in common currency

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Globalisation: trade↑, capital flows↑, migration↑, tech diffusion; WTO: rules, disputes; Blocs: EU, USMCA, ASEAN

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Country A: 10 labour hours for 1 cloth or 5 wine. Country B: 6 cloth or 4 wine. Who has comparative advantage in what? --- Solution: A: OC 1 cloth = 2 wine (10/5), 1 wine = 0.5 cloth. B: OC 1 cloth = 0.67 wine (6/4), 1 wine = 1.5 cloth. B has CA in cloth (lower OC), A has CA in wine. A exports wine, B exports cloth. Both gain
